_doc: DayZero tweaks. Each one says WHAT it changes and WHY, and every change is reversible:
before anything is changed, the old value (or 'did not exist') is saved to C:\DayZero\backup\tweaks.json,
and 'DayZero.cmd -Undo' puts everything back. A tweak whose value is already right is left alone.
Which tweaks run: a mode's own tweaks (modes.json) plus the clean-up level's (debloat.json). The
review screen lists every tweak, so any of them can be ticked or unticked there.
optional:      shown as a switch on the review screen instead of always applied (default / defaultLaptop).
warning:       shown next to the switch. laptopWarning replaces it on laptops.
phase:         'late' = runs after the apps are installed (startup and disk clean-up).
appliesTo:     windows [10,11], minBuild, formFactor desktop|laptop, gpuVendors, notVirtual, editions.
needsRestart / needsSignOut: the change takes effect after a restart / signing out.
winutil:       the Chris Titus Tech WinUtil tweak this one is modelled on (see debloat.json).
actions:
registry:         path, name, kind (DWord|String|QWord|ExpandString|Binary), value,
optional valueByEdition {EditionID: value} for edition-specific values.
registryKey:      creates a key with an empty (Default) value; undo deletes what DayZero created.
service:          name, startup (Manual|Disabled|Automatic|AutomaticDelayed); undo restores the old start type.
environment:      name, value: a machine-wide environment variable.
powerPlan:        activates Ultimate Performance, or High performance where Ultimate is not offered.
startupDisable:   turns off matching startup entries (same switch as Task Manager > Startup apps).
cleanTemp:        empties the user's and Windows' temp folders (files in use, DayZero folders and logs stay).
componentCleanup: DISM /StartComponentCleanup without /ResetBase, so updates stay uninstallable.
Hard rules (enforced in code, not just here): no scripts; no registry path that belongs to Windows
Update or Microsoft Defender; no start-type change for Windows Update, Defender, firewall, Store or
installer services. requireRestorePoint: tweaks and removals are skipped when no restore point
could be created.

tweaks.title: Turn on Game Mode
tweaks.what: Settings > Gaming > Game Mode = On (AutoGameModeEnabled = 1).
tweaks.why: While a game runs, Game Mode stops Windows Update from installing drivers and showing restart prompts, and gives the game priority. It is on by default on most PCs; this makes sure.

tweaks.title: Turn on hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.what: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling = On (HwSchMode = 2).
tweaks.why: The graphics card schedules its own memory work, which can lower latency. Windows simply ignores the setting on graphics cards or drivers that don't support it.

tweaks.title: Turn off mouse acceleration
tweaks.what: Control Panel > Mouse > Pointer Options > Enhance pointer precision = off (MouseSpeed, MouseThreshold1, MouseThreshold2 = 0).
tweaks.why: The pointer then moves exactly as far as your hand does, so aim stays consistent at any speed.

tweaks.title: Stop Store apps from running in the background
tweaks.what: Group Policy 'Let Windows apps run in the background' = Force Deny (AppPrivacy LetAppsRunInBackground = 2).
tweaks.why: Microsoft Store (UWP) apps stop using CPU, memory and network while you aren't using them. Normal desktop programs such as Steam or Discord are not affected.
tweaks.warning: Store apps such as Phone Link can't sync or notify in the background.

tweaks.title: No Bing web results in Start search
tweaks.what: Policy 'Turn off display of recent search entries in the File Explorer search box' (DisableSearchBoxSuggestions = 1), which also removes web results from Start search, plus BingSearchEnabled = 0.
tweaks.why: Start search only searches your PC: results appear faster and what you type is not sent to Bing.
tweaks.winutil: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable (DayZero's documented alternative)

tweaks.title: Turn off Widgets
tweaks.what: Group Policy 'Allow widgets' = disabled (Dsh AllowNewsAndInterests = 0).
tweaks.why: Removes the Widgets board and its news feed from the taskbar; it uses memory and network in the background.
tweaks.winutil: Widgets - Remove (turned off by policy instead of uninstalling the Web Experience Pack)

tweaks.title: Turn off News and interests
tweaks.what: Group Policy 'Enable news and interests on the taskbar' = disabled (Windows Feeds EnableFeeds = 0).
tweaks.why: Windows 10's version of Widgets: removes the weather/news feed from the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Hide Copilot
tweaks.what: Hides the Copilot taskbar button (ShowCopilotButton = 0) and sets the older 'Turn off Windows Copilot' policy. The Copilot app itself is removed by the Standard and Advanced clean-up.
tweaks.why: Keeps Copilot out of the way. You can install it again from the Microsoft Store.
tweaks.winutil: Windows AI - Disable And Remove (Copilot part)

tweaks.title: Telemetry off (lowest level this edition allows)
tweaks.what: Diagnostic data policy at its minimum (Required on Home/Pro, off on Enterprise/Education); advertising ID, tailored experiences, online speech recognition, inking and typing personalisation and contact harvesting off; no 'most used apps' tracking; Windows never asks for feedback; the Connected User Experiences and Telemetry (DiagTrack) and Windows Error Reporting services disabled; PowerShell 7 telemetry opt-out.
tweaks.why: Sends Microsoft only the minimum Windows needs to stay secure and up to date, and stops ad tracking. Windows Update and Defender keep working normally.
tweaks.warning: Crash reports are no longer sent to Microsoft or app makers, and the Run box (Win+R) stops remembering what you typed.

tweaks.title: Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences (policy)
tweaks.what: Group Policy 'Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences' (CloudContent DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures = 1).
tweaks.why: Stops promoted app installs and Store app suggestions. Windows only honours this policy on Enterprise and Education; on Home and Pro 'Stop suggested and auto-installed promoted apps' does the same job.

tweaks.title: Don't run programs stored in the firmware (WPBT)
tweaks.what: Session Manager DisableWpbtExecution = 1: Windows no longer runs the program a PC maker can put in the firmware's Windows Platform Binary Table.
tweaks.why: Some PC makers use WPBT to install their utilities (or anti-theft agents) on every fresh Windows install without asking.
tweaks.warning: Firmware-based anti-theft (e.g. Absolute/Computrace) and vendor tools that install themselves this way stop doing that.

tweaks.title: Trim background services
tweaks.what: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry (DiagTrack) and Offline Files (CscService) disabled; Downloaded Maps Manager (MapsBroker) and Storage Service (StorSvc) start only when needed (Manual).
tweaks.why: Fewer services running all the time. Windows starts the Manual ones by itself when something needs them.
tweaks.warning: Offline Files (offline copies of network-share folders, mostly used in offices) stops working.

tweaks.title: Activity history off
tweaks.what: Group Policy: don't publish or upload user activities (System PublishUserActivities = 0, UploadUserActivities = 0).
tweaks.why: Windows stops recording and syncing which apps, files and websites you used. Clipboard history keeps working.

tweaks.title: Location off
tweaks.what: Location access set to Deny for the whole PC, the location sensor override off, Maps' automatic updates off, and the Geolocation service (lfsvc) disabled.
tweaks.why: Apps and Windows can no longer see where the PC is.
tweaks.warning: Automatic time zone, Find my device, local weather and maps can no longer use your location.

tweaks.title: Don't share updates with other PCs (Delivery Optimization)
tweaks.what: Group Policy 'Download Mode' = 0 (HTTP only, no peering).
tweaks.why: Windows Update downloads straight from Microsoft and no longer uploads updates to other PCs on your network or the internet. Updates keep working.

tweaks.title: Stop File Explorer guessing folder types
tweaks.winutil: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
tweaks.what: Sets every folder's type to 'General items' (Shell\Bags\AllFolders\Shell FolderType = NotSpecified).
tweaks.why: Explorer no longer scans a folder's contents to pick a 'Pictures' or 'Music' view, which makes big folders open faster.
tweaks.warning: Folders lose their automatic layouts, e.g. Downloads is no longer grouped by date.

tweaks.title: 'End task' when right-clicking a taskbar app
tweaks.winutil: End Task With Right Click - Enable
tweaks.what: TaskbarDeveloperSettings TaskbarEndTask = 1 (the 'End task' switch in Settings > System > For developers).
tweaks.why: Close a frozen app from the taskbar without opening Task Manager.

tweaks.title: Delete temporary files
tweaks.what: Empties your TEMP folder and C:\Windows\Temp after the apps are installed. Files in use, DayZero's own folders and .log files stay.
tweaks.why: Installers leave hundreds of MB behind on a fresh PC. Nothing to undo: only temporary files are deleted.

tweaks.title: Clean up old Windows Update files
tweaks.what: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup after Windows Update: removes the Windows components that updates replaced.
tweaks.why: Frees disk space right away (Windows otherwise does it on its own schedule). Run without /ResetBase, so installed updates can still be uninstalled.

tweaks.title: Windows AI features off (Recall, Notepad AI)
tweaks.what: Group Policy 'Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall' (WindowsAI DisableAIDataAnalysis = 1) and Notepad's AI features off (WindowsNotepad DisableAIFeatures = 1). Copilot is hidden by its own tweak and its app removed by the Standard clean-up.
tweaks.why: Keeps Recall from taking screenshots of what you do, and removes the AI buttons from Notepad.

tweaks.title: Classic right-click menu in File Explorer
tweaks.what: Creates HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32 with an empty value, so Explorer shows the full Windows 10 style menu instead of 'Show more options'.
tweaks.why: Every command in one right-click, without the extra click. Undo deletes the key.

tweaks.title: Stop suggested and auto-installed promoted apps
tweaks.what: Turns off 'silently installed' promoted apps (Candy Crush and friends), app suggestions in Start and Settings, and Start's tips/new-app recommendations.
tweaks.why: Stops Windows from quietly adding sponsored apps and showing ads in Start and Settings.
tweaks.winutil: ConsumerFeatures - Disable (works on Home and Pro too)

tweaks.title: Stop launchers and chat apps from starting with Windows
tweaks.what: Turns off the startup entries of Steam, Epic Games Launcher, Discord, Spotify and Microsoft Edge's auto-launch, if they have one (the same switch as Task Manager > Startup apps).
tweaks.why: Faster sign-in and less running in the background. Start them when you need them, or switch them back on in Task Manager. Apps that only add their startup entry on first launch will show up there later.

tweaks.title: High-performance power plan
tweaks.laptopWarning: Laptop: keeps the processor at high clocks and noticeably shortens battery life. Leave it off unless you mostly play plugged in.
tweaks.what: Activates the Ultimate Performance power plan (copied from Windows' built-in template), or High performance where Ultimate isn't offered.
tweaks.why: The CPU stops dropping to low clocks between frames, which removes small stutters. Costs a little more power on desktops.

tweaks.title: Turn off Memory Integrity and VBS
tweaks.warning: SECURITY TRADE-OFF. Memory Integrity stops malicious or vulnerable drivers from taking over Windows. Turning it off can gain a few % FPS in some games, but makes the PC easier to attack. Some anti-cheat systems require it to stay on. Undo turns it back on.
tweaks.what: Core isolation > Memory integrity = off (HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity Enabled = 0) and virtualization-based security off (EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity = 0).
tweaks.why: Virtualization-based security costs some CPU performance in games on some PCs.

tweaks.title: Turn off Xbox Game Bar
tweaks.warning: Win+G, game clips and screenshots, and the controller's Xbox-button overlay stop working. Some games use Game Bar for party chat.
tweaks.what: Turns off game capture (AppCaptureEnabled = 0, GameDVR_Enabled = 0) and opening Game Bar with the controller (UseNexusForGameBarEnabled = 0). The app stays installed.
tweaks.why: Background game recording costs a little performance.
